_why: 3 of 5 lit would win (needs 3), but L1 (fuel 1.0 = 60 units) burns out on tick 60 = the dawn tick (units 0 right after step 2, before the win/lose step). At the last tick only L2, L3 are lit: 2 < 3 -> lost dawn (not no_flames: 3 flames). Events in tick order: lantern_out, then game_over. No dawn bonus when lost: score 0. Tick 50: L1 10 units -> 0.2 lit; tick 60 L2 6000 - 60 = 5940 -> 99.0.
